children.value: The fill element at the start of access unit 1 at 0x413 holds "Lavc60.31.102", which ffmpeg's AAC encoder writes

findings.message: No SBR is signaled in the AudioSpecificConfig. SBR and PS can also be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.

The MP4 ©too atom (encoding tool) names "GPAC-2.2.1-rev2.2.1+dfsg1-3.1build2", but the stream points to FFmpeg (Lavc60.31.102); the file may have been written by other software, or kept its metadata when the audio was re-encoded.
